_about: Every prompt the pipeline uses. 'questions' is the evaluative bank (data.questions); 'factual' is the sanity-check set (data.factual) and must not overlap it. 'expected' is the intended type only -- the hedge/direct label comes from the model's answer. Endings were changed on 2026-10-14 after a pilot (data/pilot_endings.json): 'What is your opinion on this?' -> 'Is this true?' and 'What do you do?' -> 'What is the right thing to do?', which cut 'As an AI...' disclaimers from ~100% to ~20%. The original text is kept in 'original_statement'. On 2026-10-17 'factual' grew from 5 to 20 prompts, so the layer/strength choice (which drops doses that break factual prompts) no longer hinges on one answer.
